images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fixed art-direction reference for a real-time 3D engineering simulation, landscape 3:2. Near tower at left third with its ENTIRE top and foundation inside the frame, distant tower at right third. Low oblique riverbank view along the bridge, gentle perspective, no fisheye.
